name: graphql-contract-review
description: Review a GraphQL schema and a Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) contract BEFORE implementation against a GraphQL checklist (nullability, N+1, cost limits, federation, BFF thinness). Use when designing or modifying a GraphQL schema, a federated subgraph, or a BFF contract. Do not use for a REST contract (use api-contract-review), an implemented schema (use review-hard or repo-consistency-sweep), or with no active task folder (run task-init first).
